# MedNova Lifesciences

MedNova Lifesciences provides regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance, clinical development, medical writing, medical information, regulatory intelligence, and training & consulting for life-sciences organisations. This file is a concise machine-readable guide to the website’s canonical pages and resources.
